name: Bicycles
desc: Group of parked bicycles with different colors
code: const s=ctx.scale||1; const x=ctx.x||0; const y=ctx.y||0; const count=Math.min(ctx.count||3,3); const colors=['#333','#333','#DD3366']; svg += `<g transform="translate(${x},${y}) scale(${s})">`; for(let b=0;b<count;b++){ const bx = b*14; svg += `<circle cx="${bx-6}" cy="4" r="7" fill="none" stroke="${colors[b]}" stroke-width="1.2"/>`; svg += `<circle cx="${bx+8}" cy="4" r="7" fill="none" stroke="${colors[b]}" stroke-width="1.2"/>`; svg += `<path d="M${bx-6} 4 L${bx+1} -4 L${bx+8} 4" fill="none" stroke="${colors[b]}" stroke-width="1.5"/>`; svg += `<line x1="${bx+1}" y1="-4" x2="${bx-4}" y2="-4" stroke="${colors[b]}" stroke-width="1.5"/>`; svg += `<line x1="${bx-4}" y1="-6" x2="${bx-4}" y2="-2" stroke="${colors[b]}" stroke-width="1"/>`; } svg += `</g>`; return svg;
